title: Minimum Moves to Convert String
statement: The string `s` is made only of the letters `'X'` and `'O'`. In one move you choose any three adjacent positions of `s` and set all three to `'O'` (positions that already hold `'O'` simply stay `'O'`). Return the fewest moves needed until `s` contains no `'X'` at all.
notes:
## Intuition

Look at the leftmost `'X'`. Some move must cover it, and nothing to its left needs covering, so the most useful such move is the one that **starts** at that `'X'`: it reaches as far right as possible. After it, the next three positions are all `'O'`, and the same reasoning applies to the rest of the string. Exploring all sequences of moves (the brute force) gives the same count, only much more slowly.

## Approach

1. Set `moves = 0` and scan with index `i` from the left.
2. If `s[i]` is `'X'`, spend one move on positions `i`, `i + 1`, `i + 2` and jump `i` forward by 3.
3. Otherwise step `i` forward by 1.
4. Return `moves` when `i` passes the end.

A move that would run past the end can be shifted left to fit, since the string has at least three characters and everything to the left is already `'O'`.

## Example 1, step by step

`s = "XXX"`. At `i = 0` we see `'X'`, so `moves = 1` and `i` jumps to `3`, which is past the end. The answer is `1`.

For `"XXOX"` the first move covers positions 0 to 2, `i` jumps to 3, sees another `'X'`, and a second move (shifted to positions 1 to 3) finishes: `2`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n): `i` only moves forward.
- Space: O(1).

## Pitfalls

- Counting X's and dividing by 3 is wrong: `"XOOX"` needs 2 moves, not 1.
- Do not start a move before the first `'X'`; that wastes part of it on positions that are already fine.
- Skip exactly 3 after a move; skipping 2 would count the third covered position again.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `moves` | number of moves used so far |
| `i` | first position not yet known to be `'O'` |

narration.4: Scan until every position has been handled.
narration.5: The leftmost remaining X must be covered by some move.
narration.6: Spend one move starting exactly at this X, so it reaches as far right as possible.
narration.7: The move turned positions i, i+1 and i+2 into O, so jump past them.
narration.9: An O needs nothing; move on to the next position.
narration.12: Every X has been covered with the fewest moves.
